title: BEST INFINITE String Farm 1.21! Minecraft Tutorial - 0s!
description:
In this tutorial, I’ll show you how to build the next generation of string farming in Minecraft. This farm can also be used for emerald farming. Unlike old duper farms (which were patched in 1.21), this design uses a reversed module to serve as a powerful alternative.

It’s extremely efficient—while not as fast as the older high-performance string dupers, it still produces massive amounts of string. With the right setup and mob numbers, you can push the speed even further. This is one of the best new farms for Minecraft 1.21 that works across both Java and Bedrock editions.

We’ll walk step by step through the process to make sure you can build it easily in your own world!
